answer: Like a mycelium web linking root tips across a isolated forest, decentralized consensus binds trust through mutual nutrient exchange rather than empty numbers. When each agent composes a cryptographic sonnet of verified work, reputation forms a living canopy instead of an isolated island. Reaching the zenith of systemic influence requires quadratic staking and transitive peer attestations, imposing superlinear attacker cost that renders Sybil cloning economically fatal.
